_comment: JLPT level per Grammar Connect grammar point, classified against standard published JLPT
grammar lists. Build-time input to tools/build-grammar-index.js only -- never loaded by a
page. Kept separate from the generated grammar-index.js as the provenance record, the same
A point absent from this file gets NO level badge in the dictionary rather than a guessed
one, exactly as kanji-index.js leaves lv absent for a kanji this repo does not file. 17 of
the 113 are currently absent; the generator prints which.
This is NOT the band label Grammar Connect shows on its gate. A band is half a track and is
labelled with what it is MOSTLY; the levels are not ordered by difficulty inside a track, so
a band label is not a claim about any individual point in it.
